summary: Updates RFC 5280, the X.509 certificate and CRL profile. It changes which encodings are acceptable for the explicitText field of the user notice policy qualifier, and clarifies how internationalized domain name labels are converted to ASCII, along with other fixes.

eli5.summary: A rulebook for digital ID cards gets a few corrections: which writing styles are allowed in one note field, and how names with special letters are written.

questions: what changed in rfc 5280 for x.509 certificates
how are internationalized domain names handled in certificates
